aggregate_schema_observation.method: Read category values and object-key sets only across the pinned QA arrays. No category-5 question/answer content or per-item results were displayed or analyzed in this scope inspection.
aggregate_schema_observation.holdout_status: Do not infer a fresh holdout from these uninspected question strings: the conversations and many related questions are exposed development data. Fresh-confirmation eligibility remains to be established independently.

primary_sources.observed: Loads source QA directly, calls the selected reader, and stores the evaluator result as model F1. No dataset-field migration is visible on this path.

Uses normalized stemmed-token multiset F1. Category 1 splits comma-separated subanswers; categories 2–4 use whole-answer F1, with category 3 taking the first semicolon segment. Category 5 separately checks abstention phrases. Evidence recall is separate from answer scoring.
Reports per-category means and an overall question-weighted aggregate across categories 1–5. Therefore the full aggregate mixes F1 with the category-5 binary rule.
The GPT full-context path renders dialog text plus BLIP captions; the dialog RAG path does likewise. These inspected paths do not render image pixels or search queries.
Category-5 preparation randomizes two options and directly indexes qa[answer] for one option; selection is decoded before scoring. The scorer also directly reads line[answer].
The release supplies image URLs, generated captions and search queries; images themselves are not distributed. Metadata provenance and reader-visible inputs must be distinguished.

local_protocol_evidence.finding: The local Mem0-paper harness computes token-set overlap after simple lowercasing and punctuation substitutions, unlike the original stemmed multiset/category-specific F1. Identical metric names do not establish equivalence.

Judge correctness is a binary JSON label obtained from question, gold answer and generated answer. This is a different instrument from token F1; citation-only edits do not alter those three fixed inputs.
Category 5 is explicitly filtered out. Its evidence-recall calculation is separate from F1 and judge labels.
Local prompts identify the Mem0-paper protocol at commit 393a4fd5 and a generous answer judge. Prompt behavior does not prove any particular unmeasured score or exemption for wrong rationale.
A separate later memory-benchmarks protocol fixes GPT-5 answerer/judge and categories 1–4. Its results must not be pooled with the older Mem0-paper reader/judge boundary.
